name: WPLS Local SEO Schema Generator
author: WP Launch Studio

sections.description:
Local SEO Schema Generator helps service businesses create clean, Google-friendly JSON-LD structured data without complexity.

Built specifically for local businesses and service-area pages.

No fake Product schema.
No bloated markup.
Just clean Local SEO.
Built for real-world service businesses – not generic schema use cases.

Core Features

  • Generate WebPage, LocalBusiness, and Service schema
  • Page-level schema control
  • Service Area targeting
  • OfferCatalog support
  • Auto inject or copy JSON-LD
  • Google Rich Results validation link
  • Global business settings
  • Service manager
  • Entity linking with @id
  • Lightweight and fast

Designed for contractors, home services, agencies, and local businesses.

How It Works

  1. Configure your business details
  2. Add your services
  3. Open any page
  4. Enter service area
  5. Click Generate Schema

That’s it.

You can auto-inject schema into your site or copy it into your favorite header plugin.

Who Is This For

  • Local businesses
  • SEO agencies
  • Contractors
  • Home service companies
  • Developers building service-area pages

Why Local SEO Schema Generator

Most schema plugins are generic.

This plugin is built specifically for:

  • Local businesses
  • Location pages
  • Local SEO

Created by WP Launch Studio.

No bloat.
No confusion.
Just results.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate plugin
  3. Go to Local Schema -> Business Settings
  4. Add your business info
  5. Add services
  6. Open any page to generate schema
